name: HelixCode Security Validation - API
description: Self-driving (§11.4.98) HelixQA bank exercising HelixCode's REAL authentication/authorization security surface at the configured base URL. Every executable step is a real http:+assert request that drives a negative security path and asserts the server rejects it with the correct status + error shape: missing Authorization header, malformed (non-Bearer) header, empty bearer, invalid-segment-count token, three-segment garbage token, SQL-injection string in the token slot, bad-credential login, malformed-JSON login body, cross-group forged-token rejection. Token-class probes forge tokens in-test (no server-side cooperation needed). NOTE: the forged tokens deliberately use NON-base64 segment placeholders so no real JWT literal is embedded in the bank (CWE-321 hygiene); the server's authMiddleware rejects them identically. Two classes the stdlib http:+assert runner cannot drive (response-header inspection, valid-token positive path) are honest _skip with reasons, never a fabricated PASS. Read-only / negative paths only — self-cleaning.

metadata.author: vasic-digital
metadata.target_server: HelixCode HTTP server (cmd/server) — real PostgreSQL + Redis backed
metadata.origin_note: Authored for HXC-029. The original helix_qa/banks/security-validation.json prose described JWT-exp-in-past + different-secret-key signing against a Catalogizer session_token login. This bank drives HelixCode's real golang-jwt-backed authMiddleware (internal/server/server.go VerifyJWTWithDB) discovered by live probing: malformed-segment-count + non-base64 + SQLi tokens are all rejected 401 'Invalid or expired token' with distinct error detail.

test_cases.name: Protected route with no Authorization header is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Missing Authorization header yields 401 with the documented message

test_cases.name: Malformed (non-Bearer) Authorization header is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Non-Bearer auth scheme is rejected with 'Invalid authorization header format'

test_cases.name: Empty bearer token is rejected as malformed header
test_cases.expected_result: An empty bearer token is treated as a malformed header (401)

test_cases.name: Single-segment token (wrong segment count) is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: A token without 3 JWT segments is rejected (Invalid or expired token)

test_cases.name: Three-segment non-base64 token is rejected (forged content)

steps.name: GET /api/v1/tasks with a forged 3-segment token
steps.expected: 401 — non-base64 segments fail decode, token rejected

test_cases.expected_result: A 3-segment token with non-base64 content is rejected with 'Invalid or expired token'

test_cases.name: Two-segment token is rejected (invalid number of segments)

steps.name: GET /api/v1/tasks with a 2-segment token
steps.expected: 401 token contains an invalid number of segments

test_cases.expected_result: A 2-segment token is rejected with 'Invalid or expired token'

test_cases.name: SQL-injection string in the token slot is rejected, not interpreted

steps.name: GET /api/v1/tasks with SQLi as bearer token
steps.expected: 401 invalid number of segments — token never reaches SQL

test_cases.expected_result: A SQL-injection payload in the token slot fails JWT parse (401) and never reaches the DB

test_cases.name: Login with bad credentials is rejected (no user enumeration leak)
test_cases.expected_result: Bad-credential login returns a generic 401 'invalid credentials'

test_cases.name: Login with empty body fails validation (400, not 500)
test_cases.expected_result: Empty login body is rejected with 400 validation, not a 500

test_cases.name: Malformed-JSON login body fails parse (400, not 500)
test_cases.expected_result: Malformed JSON login body is rejected with 400 invalid_request

test_cases.name: Logout without auth header does not succeed
test_cases.expected_result: Logout without a token does not succeed

test_cases.name: Refresh without auth header is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Token refresh without a token is rejected 401

test_cases.name: Every privileged group rejects a forged token (cross-group authz)
test_cases.expected_result: A forged token is rejected uniformly across every privileged route group

test_cases.name: Security response headers present on every response

steps.name: Assert X-Content-Type-Options / X-Frame-Options / HSTS headers
steps.expected: Response carries X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-XSS-Protection, Strict-Transport-Security
steps._skip_reason: #HXC-029-NO-HEADER-ASSERT — the stdlib HelixQA http:+assert runner (mirroring helix_qa/pkg/autonomous/http_executor.go) supports expect_status/expect_json_path/expect_body_contains but NOT response-header assertion, so the SecurityMiddleware headers cannot be asserted by this bank. Honest SKIP per Article XI §11.2.2 / §11.4.98 rather than a fabricated PASS; the headers ARE present (captured by raw curl in endpoint-probes.txt) and asserting them needs an expect_header extension to the executor.

test_cases.expected_result: Skipped honestly: runner has no expect_header capability (headers proven present via raw curl evidence)

test_cases.name: Valid-token positive authorization path (token accepted -> 200)

steps.name: GET /api/v1/users/me with a freshly-minted valid token -> 200
steps.expected: 200 with the authenticated user when bearing a valid token
steps._skip_reason: #HXC-029-REGISTER-BROKEN — POST /api/v1/auth/register returns 400 internal_auth_failed_create_user on this live DB and there is no seeded credential, so no valid token can be minted in-test to prove the positive accepted path. Honest SKIP per Article XI §11.2.2 / §11.4.98 rather than a fabricated PASS; same live register defect HXC-API-029 records. The negative rejection paths are fully proven by HXC-SEC-001..013.

test_cases.expected_result: Skipped honestly: no in-test credential path to mint a valid token for the accepted-token assertion
